entries.title: full-06's phone audio was read 30 s late: Balloon Boy parts from the host by 15 s, not at 40 s
entries.body: The audio reader paired each mask-sound onset with the nearest rebuild play within 1 s, which assumes the capture starts at game 0; it starts before the night, and the mask sound repeats every 10 s window, so the 2026-09-28 read fit three windows late. Solved over the rebuild's monitor and mask plays, the opening's five sounds (2.53 to 5.43 s) land within 0.04 s of their plays, and the capture's own start and stop stamps admit only that offset. On the corrected clock the phone's Balloon Boy hop vocals are at 10.04, 15.08 and 20.04 s, every one just after a 5 s roll; at 15.03 s the rebuild plays echo1 where the phone plays echo3b, so the two draw streams differ at or before 15 s, and the weaker 10.04 s read, where the rebuild moves him from CAM 10 silently, puts the difference at his first roll, at 5 s. The frame-trace input registration of the corrected entry stands: the phone's hall flash ends 3 to 5 updates before the replayed hall release, monitor raises land within -2..+1 updates and mask presses within 0..-1. The reader now refuses an offset that another offset fits nearly as well.
entries.label: DEVICE_MEASURED

entries.title: No office start state reproduces full-06; its strong fits share the same misses
entries.body: Pre-registered before any state but the measured seed was replayed: every one of the 65,536 office start states through the production model on full-06's own measured clock and landed contacts, scored against the phone's 42 eyehole-read mask windows. The measured seed agrees through window 6, no better than 26,557 others; no state agrees past window 23, three tie there, and start states up to 12 draws from the seed never reach window 10. By the predeclared rule that is INCONCLUSIVE, not an identified seed. The strong states miss the same windows: the two the phone reads as Withered Freddy (22 and 26), and a one-window slip of the B-then-C rhythm at 31-32. Misses every start state shares come from the mechanics or the inputs, not the seed.
entries.label: MODEL_ONLY

entries.title: At its measured seed, no single change before Balloon Boy's first roll reproduces full-06's opening
entries.body: Pre-registered: each of the nine contacts before the first mask press shifted -3..+3 updates or removed, and one or two draws added or removed after any of the first 301 updates, 1,267 members that play 16 distinct nights. None hops Balloon Boy at 5 s with the phone's vocals at 10, 15 and 20 s, and none agrees on 30 mask windows; the closest, one draw fewer at the start, agrees on 29 of 41 and plays echo1 at 15 s where the phone plays echo3b. None of the 14 seeds of the logcat bracket matches the opening audio either.
entries.label: MODEL_ONLY

entries.title: The camera static carries the random stream on screen, but the retained grid cannot identify a state
entries.body: Every 100 ms the Office sheet re-rolls the camera static's blend coefficient from Random(50), and while k3 winds through the camera glitch the static is shown at it. In full-06's retained frames the grid's mean luma, averaged over each of those periods, steps 8.6 to 16 times above its within-period noise. Pre-registered, every one of the 65,536 generator states was written into the model before each winding window: none reproduces the flicker past the chance maximum (best r 0.69-0.78). A post hoc pattern, the best states sitting a few draws past the model's count on the measured seed's own cycle, was then tested on four held-out windows and hit one (NOT_SUPPORTED). The cameras pan on their own under the static, so a third pre-registered test removed that drift from both series first, on four untouched windows: it hit none, and every window's best offset was negative. The grid cannot read this night's stream; single draws need the camera view's native pixels, which a measurement night now records (night-run.sh --static-readout), on a new attended traced night.
entries.measured: 1 of 4, then 0 of 4 detrended, held-out windows; best r 0.69-0.81
entries.label: DEVICE_MEASURED

entries.title: No office start state reproduces full-06, and the model's encounter rates are the phone's
entries.body: Pre-registered before any state but the measured seed was replayed: every one of the 65,536 office start states through the production model on full-06's own measured clock and landed contacts, scored against the phone's 42 eyehole-read mask windows. The measured seed agrees through window 6, no better than 26,557 others; no state agrees past window 23, and start states up to 12 draws from the seed never reach window 10: INCONCLUSIVE by the predeclared rule, not an identified seed. The model's per-window occupant rates over 1,000 start states are the phone's (chi-square 0.49 on 3 df), so the strong states' shared misses at the two Withered Freddy windows are his rarity; the entry this corrects read them as a mechanics gap. Their misses at windows 31-32 exceed what the rates predict.
entries.measured: best prefix 23 of 42; occupant rates chi-square 0.49 on 3 df
entries.label: MODEL_ONLY

entries.title: FNaF 1's 4/20 night is promoted: the first promotion edge outside FNaF 2
entries.body: FNaF 1's runner has no campaign executor, so Plan 12's promotion had refused its packs outright. Its checks are now read from the runner's own pack, and the terminal is the save's own mark: across the 4/20 night 420-a the title went from two stars to three, read by a core-box rule that splits all 291 slot reads of the 97 retained title frames into exactly 0.0 and 1.0. The run's dial readback names the claim (20/20/20/20), the committed winner names the run with the options and model hashes it bound, and an agent attestation through evidence attest let promote record the edge. FNaF 1 now has a committed winner, a census naming its family and held-out block, a run pack and a promotion; FNaF 3 and 4 do not.
entries.measured: title stars 2 -> 3; 291 of 291 slot reads at 0.0 or 1.0
entries.label: DEVICE_MEASURED

entries.title: Every mistake-register entry names a gate a CI lane runs
entries.body: ROADMAP S7 closes on two conditions, and one now holds: each of the fifteen register entries names the check that enforces it, and that check runs in CI. The register gate reads the entries where CLAUDE.md writes them and fails on one that is neither gated nor listed open. Five gates landed in one day, each first made to fail on a planted violation. Two found live defects: night-run.sh kept the input trace on when it could not read the phone's capabilities, and the margin map's whole-schedule phase budget for Minus Toys, 33/99 ms since August, is the edge of one band of a banded response. A third measured what a rule had assumed: Continue reads present on all 89 retained FNaF 2 title frames, so the menu fixture's fresh save, drawn without it, was the register's own mistake in fixture form. The other condition, a morning report that refutes a mechanism nobody queued, has not run.
entries.measured: 15 of 15 entries gated; Continue present on 89 of 89 title frames; latest 6 AM 3.0 s past the night over 34 won packs
entries.label: DEVICE_MEASURED
